Backend Engineer - Acme Robotics

We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our fulfillment platform team.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of experience building production backend services in Node.js or Go
- Strong understanding of distributed systems, including retries, idempotency, and eventual consistency
- Experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including schema design and query optimization
- Experience mentoring junior engineers and reviewing code thoughtfully
- Comfortable working in a distributed, mostly-async team

Nice to have:
- Experience with Kubernetes or another container orchestration platform
- Prior experience in robotics or logistics software

You will design and operate services that coordinate robot fleets in real time, working closely with the robotics and infrastructure teams.

Frontend Engineer

We need a Frontend Engineer with strong React and TypeScript skills to build our internal operations dashboard. Must be able to work independently and communicate clearly with designers and backend engineers. Experience with data-heavy UIs (tables, charts) is a plus.
Looking for a software engineer. Must know Python.

Data Engineer

We are hiring a Data Engineer to build and maintain our analytics pipelines. Requirements: 3+ years with SQL and a modern data warehouse (Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift), experience with Airflow or a similar orchestrator, and strong SQL performance-tuning skills. Nice to have: dbt experience, experience with streaming pipelines (Kafka).

Staff Software Engineer - Robotics Platform

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to lead the technical direction of our robotics coordination platform.

Requirements:
- 8+ years of software engineering experience, including designing systems at scale
- Deep experience with distributed systems and real-time coordination (e.g. robot fleets, IoT, or similar)
- Track record of mentoring senior engineers and driving cross-team technical decisions
- Excellent written communication; comfortable writing design docs and leading technical reviews

Nice to have:
- Experience in robotics, logistics, or another physical-world-adjacent domain
- Experience with ROS or similar robotics middleware

This is a hands-on technical leadership role reporting to the VP of Engineering.
